Maya Chen: Heads-up — Brightway wants a short UAT egress surge for a partner demo this Wed 16:00-20:00 PST. They asked for IP allowlist + a soft QPS bump (current plan: 30 -> 120 rps) on the us-west-2-uat peering. Renewal conversation next month, demo is high-stakes. Can we do a temporary handoff for this window? cidrs they provided: 203.0.113.0/24 :eyes:
Sam Ortiz: Confirming region: us-west-2-uat? Also need to check edge-nat pool and concurrent active connections. 120 rps for 4h sounds doable as a soft bump if we set autorevoke. Can you confirm exact start/end timestamps in UTC?
Maya Chen: Yes region = us-west-2-uat. Window: 2026-04-01T23:00:00Z to 2026-04-02T03:00:00Z (4h). Please also add a note in the account about renewal risk and that CS will capture latency before/after.
Priya Nair: For peering we need the peer-id and whether they originate from a fixed nat. Also: are they using mTLS or standard HTTPS? If it's NATed behind our edge, we'll need to expand the peering ACL and whitelist the /24.
Devin Ramos: One quick config snippet we can push to the enforce layer (as a temp policy):
```
# temp rate override
policy: temp_qps_override
scope: customer:brightway, region:us-west-2-uat
qps: 120
allowlist_cidrs:
  - 203.0.113.0/24
autorevoke: 48h
reason: partner demo, requested by CSM Maya Chen
```
Sam Ortiz: That looks good. Implementation notes: we'll set a soft limit (nginx bucket) so we don't hard-block other traffic. I'll validate NAT pool capacity and apply the ACL to the uat-egress route table. If edge-nat is full we'll fallback to token-throttling policy and notify.
Priya Nair: Peer-id = brt-001, they confirmed origin IPs are static, no mTLS, standard TLS. I'll open the ACL and add the CIDR. Also flag: do NOT apply to prod or to service-tokens group.
Liam Park: Quick commercial note — Brightway's renewal is 2026-04-15. Delivering a smooth demo materially affects NRR. Appreciate the 48h autorevoke. Can CS get a simple latency delta after the demo to attach to the renewal playbook?
Maya Chen: Yep — I'll run 10 pre/demo prompts and 10 post/demo prompts vs. the same seed prompts and paste results here. Can ops tstamp when the change goes live so I can align the test?
Sam Ortiz: Will do. Plan: 1) apply allowlist + route change at 2026-04-01T23:00:00Z, 2) flip soft qps to 120, 3) monitor for 5m for anomalies, 4) send a go/no-go message. If no regressions, keep until 48h autorevoke unless Maya requests earlier revoke.
deploy-bot: policy-change: temp_qps_override applied to customer:brightway region:us-west-2-uat at 2026-04-01T23:00:37Z by ops/sam. ACL entry brt-001 -> 203.0.113.0/24 added. Autorevoke scheduled in 48h.
Devin Ramos: Adding quick troubleshooting pointers for CS: if the demo shows 429s, check token usage header X-Redwood-QPS and the edge logs at /var/log/edge/us-west-2-uat/access.log. Example grep: `grep 203.0.113. /var/log/edge/us-west-2-uat/access.log | grep 429`
Maya Chen: Got it — thanks all. I'll post latency samples in this thread after the demo. Also noting in the account: "demo allowlist + 120rps soft bump, auto-revoke 48h, renewal 2026-04-15"
Sam Ortiz: Closing loop: applied and monitoring. Will post a short ops summary after revoke. :white_check_mark:
